description: Decodes ABI-encoded hex for the given types (same type support as abi.encode). Strict: every length and offset is bounded by the data present, dirty padding bits and trailing bytes are rejected, and calldata with a 4-byte selector is flagged. Integers are returned as decimal strings, addresses checksummed. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

types.description: Solidity ABI types to decode into.

name: abi.decode
title: ABI-decode data
